therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: protein degradation pathway disruption leading to myeloma cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with multiple myeloma in first relapse or refractory to first-line therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: overall response rate after 8 courses of treatment
